outputGuard: Output must be a nonexistent directory outside the repository; all hashes, package versions and current runtime contracts are checked before it is created.

archivePolicy.layout: Preserved individual files; entire source tree is below 32MiB, so no extra archive duplication is necessary.

archiveBuildMode: Source-only mode verifies the pinned sources, scripts, 84 output hashes and all saved contracts; it does not require or claim verification of an installed application runtime.
